item.content:encoded:
Nature Reviews Earth & Environment, Published online: 07 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s43017-026-00840-9

item.title: Environmental impacts, surveillance and mitigation of antimicrobial resistance
item.content:encoded:
Nature Reviews Earth & Environment, Published online: 07 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s43017-026-00837-4

The environment has an important role in the emergence and spread of antimicrobial resistance (AMR). This Review discusses the global patterns of AMR distribution and sources and drivers of AMR, and it proposes a standardized surveillance framework to support integrated monitoring, risk assessment and mitigation efforts worldwide.
